name: BARYTA ACETICA
key_symptoms: Drawing pain down whole left leg. Crawling, with burning stitches. Paralysis. Lumbago and rheumatic pain in muscles and joints.
guiding_symptoms: Drawing pain down whole left leg. Crawling, with burning stitches. Paralysis. Lumbago and rheumatic pain in muscles and joints.
mind_symptoms: Forgetful; wavering long between opposite resolutions. Lack of self confidence.
